rationales: Metalloids do not generally form ionic compounds with metals.
Noble gases are mostly unreactive and do not usually form ionic compounds with metals.
Halogens gain electrons from metals to form ionic compounds.
Transition elements are metals and do not typically form ionic compounds with other metals.
Diffusion is the mixing of particles through random motion, not escape through a tiny hole.
Compression is the reduction of a gas’s volume under pressure.
Effusion is the escape of gas molecules through a tiny hole into a lower-pressure region.
Density is mass per unit volume.
A compound is a substance formed by chemical combination, not the general name for a water-based solution.
Sugar is one possible substance that can dissolve in water.
Electricity is not the name of a solution formed in water.
A solution in which water is the solvent is called an aqueous solution.
Oxygen is not −4 in peroxides.
Oxygen is not −3 in peroxides.
Oxygen is −2 in most compounds, but not in peroxides.
Oxygen has oxidation number −1 in peroxides.
Dobereiner proposed triads, not the first widely recognized periodic table.
Newlands proposed the law of octaves, not the first widely recognized periodic table.
Mendeleev is credited with creating the first widely recognized periodic table of elements.
Dalton proposed an atomic theory, not the first periodic table.
Iron is not the most abundant metal in Earth’s crust.
Copper is much less abundant than aluminium in Earth’s crust.
Aluminium is the most abundant metal in Earth’s crust.
Zinc is much less abundant than aluminium in Earth’s crust.
Unemployment is not the intended environmental effect of chemical industry development.
Malnutrition is not the intended effect described here.
Chemical industry development can generate polluted air.
Lack of transport is not the intended effect described here.
Physical chemistry studies the physical principles underlying chemical systems.
Industrial chemistry studies the manufacture of chemical compounds on a commercial scale.
Inorganic chemistry studies inorganic substances, not specifically their commercial manufacture.
Biochemistry studies chemical processes in living organisms.
Dalton’s atomic model did not involve experiments with particles passing through foil.
Bohr developed a model of the atom but did not make this foil observation.
J.J. Thomson’s work involved cathode rays, not the foil-scattering experiment.
Rutherford observed that most alpha particles passed through the foil undeflected.
The M shell has three subshells, not one.
For principal quantum number 3, the M shell contains three subshells: 3s, 3p, and 3d.
The M shell has three subshells, not two.
Four subshells correspond to the N shell, not the M shell.
Rust is commonly represented as hydrated iron(III) oxide, Fe₂O₃·nH₂O.
Fe₂O₃ alone does not show the water present in rust.
Fe(OH)₃·nH₂O is not the usual formula used for rust.
Fe(OH)₃ is not the usual formula used for rust.
Hydrogen has the lowest molar mass among these gases and therefore diffuses fastest.
Helium is lighter than fluorine and chlorine but heavier than hydrogen.
Fluorine is much heavier than hydrogen and helium, so it diffuses more slowly.
Chlorine is the heaviest listed gas and diffuses slowest.
HCl and H₂O both contain polar covalent bonds.
C₂H₂ contains nonpolar C–C bonds and nearly nonpolar C–H bonds, although water is polar.
N₂ has a nonpolar covalent bond, although water is polar.
Cl₂ and O₂ are homonuclear molecules with nonpolar covalent bonds.
Sodium chloride does not boil at 0 °C.
Sodium chloride does not boil at 100 °C.
Sodium chloride’s boiling point is much higher than 800 °C.
Sodium chloride boils at approximately 1413 °C.
CH₂O is not the empirical formula of benzene.
CHO is not the empirical formula of benzene.
C₂H₂ is the molecular formula of ethyne, not benzene’s empirical formula.
Benzene, C₆H₆, simplifies to the empirical formula CH.
